name: Non-Immigrant O Visa (Marriage/Family)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a legally registered marriage to a Thai citizen, with evidence the relationship is genuine.
Requires at least THB 400,000 held in a Thai bank account, or monthly income of at least THB 40,000, to demonstrate financial support for the couple.
requirements.fix_path: Document at least THB 400,000 in a Thai bank account, or qualifying monthly income.

requirement_groups.name: Minor child of a Thai citizen or foreign resident

requirements.blocker_text: Covers minor children of a Thai citizen or of a foreign national holding valid long-term Thai residence status.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate or birth certificate proving the qualifying family relationship
Proof of funds or income (spouse track)
90-day address reporting to Immigration Bureau once resident

sources.title: HelloThailand -- Thailand Long Term Visa Options in 2026, describing the Non-O marriage-visa funds requirement

notes: STATUS: DRAFT. HONEST SOURCING GAP: no direct fetch of an Immigration Bureau page was achieved for this route in this research pass. work_rights is correctly 'none': a Non-O marriage visa alone does not authorise employment -- a separate work permit application is required even for spouses of Thai citizens, a structurally stricter position than several other countries in this dataset (e.g. Poland's family-reunification routes grant full work rights automatically). Marriage to a Thai citizen has a genuine, faster naturalisation track under the Nationality Act, distinct from this route's own general pipeline figures -- see th_naturalisation for the marriage-specific detail, which this route's outcome fields don't fully capture given the diversity of the underlying population (spouses vs. dependent children follow different downstream timelines).
